subtitle: AI CE Image Mode: turning architectural floor-plan images into structured, reviewable information through image analysis, OCR, and observable service operations. Computer vision, model serving, and MLOps in one system.
contributions: Designed and developed the system end to end: image preparation, detection, segmentation, OCR, and structured output.
Built the inference service (FastAPI) with batch and API workflows, validation, and result packaging.
Set up operations: Redis-backed observability, systemd supervision, nginx reverse proxy, Prometheus metrics, and Grafana dashboards.
Laid the MLOps foundation: artifact transfer, evaluation plans, and version tracking for reviewed retraining.
